stories.title: ‘The first of our lives’: Thousands in Spain rush for best spot to watch total solar eclipse (3/4)
stories.summary: Thousands of people in Spain were buzzing with excitement as they dashed to find the best location from which to view Wednesday's total solar eclipse. Trains were jam packed, travellers booked last-minute carpools and social media users shared the best viewing spots. FRANCE 24 met several eclipse enthusiasts as they set off from Madrid.
